approvedInstitutionalCandidates.name: Kunstnerforbundet
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.institutionalScope: Independent artist-run, non-commercial exhibition and mediation institution established in 1910, in the same self-owned Kjeld Stubs gate 3 building since 1917.
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.overlapAudit: No canonical place within 35 m and no current canonical identity match.

approvedInstitutionalCandidates.name: Fotogalleriet
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.institutionalScope: Independent non-commercial photographic art institution founded in 1977, with a persistent public exhibition identity and current main premises in Møllergata 34.
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.coordinateBlockReason: The official institution address is published as Møllergata 34 without a letter. Geonorge exposes four distinct address points 34A-D, and no exact named OSM institution object was found. No first-hit, nearest-letter or synthetic centroid may be used as canonical coordinate.
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.overlapAudit: No canonical identity match and no canonical place within 35 m of the address-cluster audit centroid.

approvedInstitutionalCandidates.name: SOFT galleri
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.institutionalScope: Independent textile-art gallery founded in 2006 and operated by Norske Tekstilkunstnere, with its own exhibition programme, public visitor function and dedicated exhibition room at Rådhusgata 20.
approvedInstitutionalCandidates.coordinateBlockReason: The ordinary official address point for Rådhusgata 20 is exactly the same canonical display marker already used by the institution-specific place `fotografiens_hus`. SOFT is a different institution, but production must wait for a separately documented entrance/visitor anchor or other non-duplicate physical marker rather than creating two exact-overlap map points.

parentReuse.basis: Oslo Kunstforening is a persistent non-commercial institution founded in 1836 and has occupied the second floor of Rådmannsgården since 1936. Its exact Geonorge address point at Rådhusgata 19 is identical to the existing canonical Rådmannsgården/Anatomibygget marker. The existing parent record explicitly uses one shared marker to avoid overlapping places on the same cultural-historic property. Add Oslo Kunstforening as a current institutional layer to the parent instead of creating a duplicate marker.

scopeGuards: This report closes only the 13-item official VisitOSLO curated gallery priority tranche, not the full client-rendered Galleries category.
The failed full-category source-discovery PR #3433 remains a technical audit trail; no full-category completeness claim is permitted until a reproducible source snapshot exists.
Private/commercial gallery listings remain deferred under the existing Oslo gallery policy unless a consistent inclusion framework is explicitly adopted.
Institutional durability can justify a new canonical place, but exact co-location must still pass the one-place/one-physical-identity and map-marker overlap gates.
Fotogalleriet and SOFT galleri are scope-approved but must not be produced until exact non-guessed coordinate anchors are resolved.
Oslo Kunstforening resolves to the existing Rådmannsgården parent and should be added as a current-use/institution layer, not as a new marker.
